title: TCS Nashik case: Court cites ‘prison-birth’ stigma to grant bail to pregnant accused Nida Khan
description: A Nashik court recently granted bail to Nida Khan, accused in the Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) Nashik BPO sexual harassment and religious coercion case, citing her pregnancy and the social stigma attached to the child if born in prison [Nida Khan v. State of Maharashtra & Anr].
